Thomas Grahame Bailey\.
*The Languages of the Northern Himalayas: Being Studies in the Grammar of Twenty\-six Himalayan Dialects*\.
Volume XII of Asiatic Society Monographs\.
Royal Asiatic Society, London, 1908\.
Bailey's primary Bhalesi lexical comparison list, distinct from Bhadrawahi, Padari and Pangwali\. LSI IX\(IV\) p\. 886 repeats several Bhalesi forms and Zoller 2023 cites its woman cell; that already represented same\-print cell is excluded here\.
